title: NoobGlist
body:
# NoobGlist – Advanced Global Player List for Velocity
NoobGlist is a lightweight and customizable /glist command for Velocity-powered proxy servers. It allows server admins and players to view a list of online players across all servers in the network, with clickable server links for easy switching.

## 🔹 Features:

✔ Display all online players grouped by server           
✔ Clickable server names to join instantly (/server or /queue integration)               
✔ Fully customizable messages using MiniMessage formatting             
✔ Permission-based config reload command (/glist reload)           
✔ Supports aliases: /glist, /nglist, /players, /nplayers, /nlist              

## 🔹 Usage:

/glist – View the online players across all servers             
/glist reload – Reloads configuration (Requires noobglist.reload)             

## 🔹 Installation:

1️⃣ Download NoobGlist.jar and place it in your Velocity plugins folder             
2️⃣ Restart the server           
3️⃣ Customize the messages in config.yml         
4️⃣ Use /glist to see player activity across the network          

## 💡 Customizable Config:
Modify the player list format, hover text, and more in config.yml. Default placeholders:

%server% – Server name

%playersnum% – Number of players on a server

%players% – List of player names

%totalplayers% – Total online players

### 🚀 Enhance your Velocity proxy with a powerful global player list!
